  Line or code reference: Lines 134-136 (DISPATCHED_REVIEW_WORKFLOW, DISPATCHED_REVIEW_TITLE, DISPATCHED_REVIEW_RUNS_PATH) and lines 321-336 (_is_pr_dispatched_review_run), 282-310 (_active_run_count), 457-459 (_check_claude_fixer_pr verification path)
  severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The check_in_status.py changes only recognize internal-review.yml dispatch runs, while consumer repos dispatch ai-review.yml from the default branch, so the checker cannot find or verify those runs.
  WHY: In a consumer repo, a claude/* PR gets an ai-review.yml dispatch from the default branch. The §26 checker runs check_in_status.py --hand-back. _check_claude_fixer_pr finds the hand-off, fetches the review run (path=ai-review.yml, head_branch=default, event=workflow_dispatch, display_title=`AI Review [pr:<N>]`). Line 455 passes (ai-review.yml is in FIXER_WORKFLOW_PATHS). Line 457: _is_pr_dispatched_review_run returns False (path is ai-review.yml, not internal-review.yml). Line 458: head_branch != head_ref is True (default branch vs PR head). Result: "waiting for verified completed review run" — the hand-off is never verified, the fixer is never woken, the PR sits until the 7-day dead-man's switch. Similarly, check_pr's stuck path (line 276) calls _active_run_count which returns 0 (head-branch lookups miss the default-branch run, internal-review.yml listing 404s), falsely reporting the PR as "stuck" while a review dispatch is actively running. Before #4701, the poller dispatched with --ref <head_branch>, so head-branch lookups found the run. After #4701, neither lookup finds it in consumer repos. This is a regression in consumer repos only.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
